gloss: complete set of volumes; all volumes

definitions.gloss: complete set of volumes; all volumes
definitions.explanation: The entire set of volumes in a series, such as a manga, novel series, or encyclopedia. Frequently used when buying or discussing the full collection.

examples.japanese: あの{漫画|まんが}を{全巻|ぜんかん}{揃|そろ}えた。
examples.english: I collected all the volumes of that manga.

examples.japanese: {全巻|ぜんかん}セットで{買|か}うと{安|やす}くなる。
examples.english: It's cheaper if you buy the complete set.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}しのとき、{漫画|まんが}の{全巻|ぜんかん}セットを{段|だん}ボールに{詰|つ}めるのが{大変|たいへん}だった。
examples.english: When moving, it was tough packing the complete manga sets into cardboard boxes.

notes:
USAGE:
Very common in manga and book culture. Online retailers frequently offer {全巻|ぜんかん}セット (complete set) deals. Also used for encyclopedias and other multi-volume works.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {全巻|ぜんかん}セット (complete set)
- {全巻|ぜんかん}{揃|そろ}える (to collect all volumes)
- {全巻|ぜんかん}{読破|どくは} (reading all volumes through)
- {全巻|ぜんかん}{無料|むりょう} (all volumes free)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {既刊|きかん}: already published volumes — the volumes released so far in an ongoing series
- {全集|ぜんしゅう}: collected works — a comprehensive collection of an author's writings
